key_features: Take one hassle out of back to school shopping and buy a School Supply Box filled with everything your elementary student needs. This 12x10x4-inch school supply pack includes: (1) 1" binder, (5) 3 prong folders, (1) pk wide ruled 100-sheet loose leaf paper, (1) wide ruled composition book, (3) wide ruled spiral notebooks, (1) 24pk Crayons, (1) 12pk Colored Pencils, (1) 10 pack broadline markers, and (2) Glue Sticks.

Stay organized and ready for anything with the included (1) pencil bag, (2) pink erasers, (1) pencil sharpener, (6) mechanical pencils, (2) 0.7mm lead refills, (1) pk 100ct index cards, (1) 8pk of #2 pencils, (3) pencil grips, (6) pencil top erasers, (1) 5" blunt tip scissors, and (1) tissue pocket pack.

This massive school supply kit contains everything your child needs for the first day of school and beyond. Whether it’s for homework, studying, or writing assignments, this kit is ready to go! The tools included are also great for note-taking, flashcards, and keeping organized throughout the year.
School Supply Boxes don’t have to be just for students—this kit also makes a great gift for a teacher, tutor, homeschooling family, or anyone looking to stock up on school essentials.

Forget shopping around for everything on the school supply list this year. Beyond students, the school supply box is a great kit to give to a elementary school teacher, middle school teacher, high school teacher, tutor, homeschooler, writer, college instructor, or professor who buys supplies all year. Buying in bulk is the most economical way to save money and when it comes to school supplies, is the easiest way to get everything you need without ever having to step foot in a store.
review_summary: Every parent has experienced the frustration of buying school supplies. Crowds and limited supplies at box stores can make it impossible to find everything on your child's school supply list quickly. Shopping early might help, but who wants to shop for school supplies in July? And if you’re one of those last minute shoppers, you often have to take what you can find no matter if it might not be the best quality. We saw this and thought there had to be a better way.
